verdict.rationale: Docs say Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with its own persistent workspace, and sensitive actions such as sending email or deploying code can be approved or denied. That gives isolated execution and a human gate before production-affecting steps. However, its connectors (Gmail, Snowflake, Salesforce, GitHub and others) act on live accounts, and nothing shows a dedicated test or staging mode. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or mock data separate from connected production services, guidance on keeping test runs away from live data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
